items.bio_en:
Dr. Ping-Yang Yeh is a seasoned biopharmaceutical executive with over 30 years of global experience in biologics development. He has held senior leadership roles at Amgen, Biogen, and GSK during his time in the United States. After returning to Taiwan, he assumed executive positions at EirGenix and AltruBio, where he focused on biologics CDMO operations and novel biologic drug development.

Dr. Yeh's career spans the full product lifecycle, including discovery, development, commercialization, and lifecycle management of proteins, monoclonal antibodies, and small molecules. He has led cross-functional efforts in molecular design, process and product development, manufacturing, and technology innovation. His contributions include the launch of 18 commercial products — such as Tysabri, Plegridy, Repatha, Blincyto, Aimovig, Kyprolis, and Neulasta Onpro — as well as involvement in more than 45 IND and IND amendment submissions across the United States and Europe. His expertise includes CMC strategy, biologics process and product development, drug delivery, technology platform innovation, and operational excellence.

Dr. Yeh holds a Ph.D. in Molecular Pharmaceutics from University of Utah, where he trained under Jindřich Kopeček, a pioneer in polymer-based drug delivery systems. He has also completed executive education at MIT Sloan School of Management.

items.bio_en:
Victoria Wang is a seasoned investor and entrepreneur with over three decades of experience spanning venture investment, medical device commercialization, and healthcare innovation across the U.S., Asia, and Europe. Her experience bridges investing, operating leadership, and strategic advisory work across the life sciences and healthcare sectors.

Most recently, Victoria served as Investment Principal at Taiwania Capital Management Corporation's Bio Fund, where she contributed to multiple investments across medical devices, AI-enabled diagnostics, and bio-converging drug discovery, while supporting portfolio development and fund management. She has also served on the boards of multiple companies in medical therapeutics, precision diagnostics, and life science research tools, advising on governance, regulatory strategy, market access, and commercialization.

Earlier in her career, Victoria co-founded and led Renew Biocare Corporation for nearly two decades, advancing implantable and imaging-based medical devices, including more than ten products that achieved U.S. Food and Drug Administration and CE Mark approvals.

Victoria holds an MS in Health Policy & Management from National Taiwan University and is completing her MBA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. She also earned a BBA from the University of Alaska Anchorage after completing undergraduate pre-medical course requirements at Simon Fraser University.

items.bio_en:
Charlene Hu is a seasoned investor and executive with a strong track record across venture capital, strategic investment, and business operation in the high-tech and biomedical sectors. Her diverse leadership experience spans investment, strategy, and business development, positioning her uniquely to identify, cultivate, and scale innovative ventures.

Earlier in her career, Charlene spent over 20 years in corporate venture at Intel and Hermes-Epitek, leading strategic investments and portfolio management in semiconductors and biomedical industries and supporting portfolio companies in growth and synergy creation. She also held the role VP of Sales & Marketing at a MEMS sensor company, where she was responsible for global business development, channel strategy, and revenue growth - giving her deep operational insight and a customer-centric view of scaling technology businesses.

In addition to her executive roles, Charlene has served on the boards of multiple companies in the tech and biomedical industries, contributing to strategic direction, fundraising, and commercialization strategy.

Charlene holds an MS in Operations Research from Stanford University. She received BS in Applied Mathematics and EMBA from National Chiao Tung University.

items.title_zhTW: 共同創辦人暨科學顧問委員會主席
items.bio_en:
Dr. Maggie Lu has dedicated her 30 years' career to delivering innovative solutions and driving value creation across the biotech and pharma area. These innovations include first-in-class drugs, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), active targeting delivery systems, nanoparticles and lipid vesicles, depot formulations, and transdermal systems. Her work has addressed critical medical needs across diverse therapeutic areas including oncology, CNS disorders, ophthalmology, pulmonary diseases, and pain management.

She has established extensive networks and fostered collaborations with leading pharmaceutical and biotech organizations worldwide. Her leadership encompasses comprehensive business management, providing strategic initiatives and operational excellence. She led pharmaceutical R&D teams at ITRI and Metagone, successfully advancing products from bench research through preclinical and clinical development stages.

Her management expertise spans the full spectrum of business operations, including fundraising, company building and IPO preparation. Her achievements and contributions have been recognized through 40 prestigious awards. Dr. Lu currently serves as Vice President and General Director of Biomedical Technology and Device Research Laboratories at ITRI.

items.bio_en:
Audrey Tseng, Honorary Deputy Chairman of PwC, with over 30 years of experience, advises leading corporations and over 20 listed companies on IPO readiness, corporate governance, restructuring, and tax strategies across industries including electronics, biotech, healthcare, retail, and finance.

Audrey is a distinguished leader in biotechnology, digital health, and corporate governance, with extensive experience guiding companies across the life sciences ecosystem. She currently serves as an Independent Director at Delta Electronics, Inc., Asustek Computer Inc., Bionime Corporation, and Onward Therapeutics SA, and sits on the boards of BRIM Biotechnology Inc. and ST. Shine Optical Co., Ltd. Audrey is also an Adjunct Professor at National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University, Vice Chairman of the Taiwan Digital Health Industry Development Association, and Executive Director of the Taiwan Bio-Industry Organization.

During her tenure at PwC Taiwan, Audrey founded and led the firm's biotechnology industry service team, establishing PwC Taiwan as a leading advisory powerhouse in the biotech sector. She successfully supported numerous biopharma and MedTech companies through critical stages of growth — from early-stage development to public listings in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Nasdaq. Her leadership roles at PwC included Deputy Chairman, Assurance Leader, Markets Leader, and Industry Development Leader, as well as Synergies Leader for PwC CaTSH (Greater China), where she drove cross-market integration and strategic collaboration.

Since her retirement from PwC, Audrey has continued to shape the biotechnology landscape through directorship and supervisory roles, actively contributing to strategic planning and corporate governance across multiple companies. As an investment committee member for several venture capital funds, she brings a sharp and comprehensive understanding of emerging trends, scientific innovation, and market dynamics that will define the future of the global biotech industry. She also serves on the Advisory Committee of the Bio Taiwan Committee (BTC).

items.bio_en:
Dr. Jane Tsai leverages over three decades of biomedical innovation and executive leadership to transform research into global business value. Her career spans industry, institutes, academia, hospitals, and consultancy, where she has forged interdisciplinary partnerships to accelerate breakthroughs and deliver lasting impact.

She has advised entrepreneurship programs and global consulting firms and contributed to international standards and regulatory harmonization bodies. She also brings deep expertise in valuations to her role as a Venture Capital Investment Committee Member.

Currently Senior Vice President at YFY Biotech Management, Dr. Tsai also serves as Senior Advisor, after earlier leadership roles as Deputy General Director and Chief Operating Officer at ITRI. At Roche Diagnostics, she directed diverse R&D programs and guided cross-functional teams from concept to commerce, driving global launches and lifecycle management. She played a pivotal role in Global Strategic Visioning, M&A transitions and integration, business development, patent committee, and key opinion leader engagement.

Her research expertise was shaped as a scientist and Principal Investigator at a National Cancer Institute NCI‑designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, and as research faculty and postdoctoral fellow at Penn State University, where she earned her doctorate. She also worked at National Taiwan University Hospital after earning a BS from NTU.

Dr. Tsai is a Project Management Professional and earned a Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. She is a Fellow of the Association of Diagnostics and Laboratory Medicine (FADLM) and is a longstanding member of several leading biomedical organizations, including AACR (Cancer Research) and AAPS (Pharmaceutical Scientists).

items.bio_en:
Dr. Patrik Frei is founder and CEO of Venture Valuation AG (www.venturevaluation.com), Switzerland. He started the company in 1999 when he noticed a need for independent valuation services in high growth industries during a collaboration with Novartis Venture Fund, which became his first client. Since then he has been involved in over 800 valuations around the globe for investors as well as Biotech, Pharma and Medtech companies.

From 2013 to 2016 Patrik built the APAC Office of Venture Valuation in Singapore/Malaysia. Venture Valuation also runs Biotechgate (www.biotechgate.com), a global business development Life Sciences database including company/product profiles, licensing deal information and investors. The most recent product is HelloPartnering (www.hellopartnering.com), a one2one business conference and match-making application used in over 15 conferences per year. Furthermore, Patrik and Venture Valuation started its own virtual conference series (Biotechgate Digital Partnering) in 2020 and now runs 3-4 conferences per year with 900-1,200 participants per conference (www.digitalpartnering.com).

Patrik graduated from the Business University of St. Gallen in Finance and completed his Ph.D thesis ("Assessment and valuation of high growth companies") at the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology, EPFL Lausanne. Patrik was a board member and one of the original founders of Ineo (holding company of the Swiss dental implant VC-backed firm Thommen Medical). Furthermore, Patrik was a member of the board of Kleinkraftwerk Birseck AG (KKBN: Berne), a publicly quoted cleantech company.

Patrik's articles have been published in a number of scientific journals including "Nature Biotechnology", "Drug Discovery Today" and other business publications ("Starting a Business in the Life Sciences: From Idea to Market" and "Building Biotechnology: Starting, Managing, and Understanding Biotechnology Companies"). He has also lectured at Seoul National University, South Korea; EPFL Lausanne; University of St. Gallen; Trinity College Dublin and gives regular workshops on valuation in Asia, Europe and the US. Patrik is also a reviewer for the Nature journals.

items.bio_en:
Michael Su is a pioneering biotech leader with deep expertise in drug discovery and translational medicine. Michael was President and Chief Scientific Officer of Volastra Therapeutics. He led the Volastra team to the discovery of a first-in-class KIF18A inhibitor for metastatic ovarian cancer.

Michael also served as Chief Scientific Officer of Decibel Therapeutics where he led the discovery of a novel, clinically successful gene therapy treatment for Otoferlin-deficient deafness. Before Decibel, Michael served as co-founder and Senior Vice President of Research and Development at Agios Pharmaceuticals. During his time at Agios, Michael led the team responsible for identifying oncogenic targets for the company's lead mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase programs and led the discovery of the resulting approved drugs Enasidenib and Ivosidenib. He also guided drug discovery in the rare genetic diseases franchise leading to the discovery of pyruvate kinase activator, Mitapivat, for treatment of anemia.

Michael was the General Director and Vice President of the Biomedical Engineering Research Laboratory (BEL) at ITRI in Taiwan between 2004-2006. Prior, he spent 14 years in various managerial roles at Vertex Pharmaceuticals.

Michael received his Ph.D. in biochemistry from Duke University and was a Helen Hay Whitney fellow in biochemistry and molecular biology at Harvard University.
